candidates.title: Adults with developmental disabilities
candidates.reason: Current units cover pediatric developmental delay and disability etiologies but not the objective's adult-specific consent, adapted communication, preventive care, health-disparity, caregiver, and interdisciplinary-management competencies.

duplicate_check.method: Deterministic normalized-title, canonical-objective-ID, cross-discipline-note, competency-text, and chapter/category search across all 1,486 existing study units, followed by semantic review of the bounded candidate set.
duplicate_check.reason: The closest units separately cover pediatric intellectual disability or etiologies, generic consent/capacity, or generic health equity; none integrates the adult-specific developmental-disability assessment, adapted communication, consent, caregiver, preventive-care, health-disparity, and interdisciplinary-management competency.
